notes.title: XEL Patch 1.0.6.370 is available now!
notes.notes:
Hi there! 
We got another XEL patch for you, [b]version 1.0.6.370 is now live[/b] for you to enjoy! 

The most important change of course that you can enter the boss area in the Scorched Wasteland (Dungeon 3) again. Time to get your butt kicked, yay!

As promised the list below not only contains the current changes but also the changes from the previous update (sorry, we missed sharing a proper changelog with you):

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where you got stuck when entering the boss area in the Scorched Wasteland (Dungeon 3)
[*] Fixed some water not acting like water. How rude.
[*] Fixed some ladders that you could climb down but not back up
[*] Fixed not being able to leave shirls shop after purchasing all items
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would get stuck when entering the finale
[*] Fixed several locations where you could get stuck
[*] Fixed some occasions where the game got stuck after loading a file
[*] Fixed a bug where snow was still active when fasttraveling from the Glacial Glades to Needle Eye
[*] Removed the passage between Glacial Glades, Bog and The Divide for performance reasons
[*] Fixed Chap
[*] Fixed Minimap not updating properly under certain circumstances
[*] Fixed a chest that was already open when restarting the game in the Bog
[*] Fixed some wonky loading triggers
[*] Fixed an issue where you could get stuck in the Science Station (Dungeon 2)
[*] Fixed an invisible NPC near the Divide
[*] Fixed Reid's backpack rendering black
[*] Fixed being stuck in the finale because the window wouldn't break
[*] Removed the passage between Glacial Glades, Bog and The Divide for performance reasons[/list]

[h3]Additions & Improvements[/h3]
[list][*] Added Chap UI animation to all loading scenarios
[*] Improved a lot of unneccessary Pop-Ins (geometry appearing out of nowhere)[/list]


[b]A big thank you for your ongoing support![/b]

[i][b]-Your Teams of Tiny Roar & Assemble Entertainment-[/b][/i]

notes.title: First XEL Patch released!
notes.notes:
Dear community, 

We would like to thank you for a great launch of our first major title XEL. We are still thrilled we came this far and made our dream come true.

We keep reading your comments and reviews and appreciate all your feedback. We are currently working on a major update (1.0.4) that will address lots of bugs and requested features (such as a quest marker or remappable controls on gamepads). We don’t have a date yet for the patch, but rest assured we are working tirelessly to push it out as soon as possible.  

Meanwhile, we uploaded a first patch today, fixing some of the annoying stuff, such as blockers in certain areas that prevented a few players from progressing.  

[b]A full list of the changes, which are live now, can be found below:[/b] 

[list]
[*] Fixed Terminal in Glacial Glades (some players were not able to open the door to the Glacial Glades) 
[*] Fixed several out of bounds / falling through world bugs 
[*] Fixed Evander re-appearing again after dying 
[*] Added Chinese, Japanese and Korean character names  
[*] Updated Chinese and Japanese Localization 
[*] Additional Video Compression and Codec changes  
[*] Some Animation tweaks  
[*] Some UI tweaks 
[*] Fixed Dialogue bugs where players could walk away from quest-relevant NPCs 
[*] Fixed Discord- and FAQ-links in main menu not working 
[/list]

You can expect more bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements within the next couple of days and weeks to improve XEL’s experience. 

We did identify some smaller issues with this patch that we are also working to fix for the next update:
[list]
[*] Coming back to the main menu, you might need to click your mouse once to be able to select anything
[*] Restarting the game might reset your master audio to 0
[*] An active dialogue audio may be played until the end even when the player goes back into main menu
[/list]

Thank you for your support and patience so far. 

[b]Tiny Roar & Assemble Entertainment [/b]

notes.title: XEL, the Sci-Fi Adventure, Gets a Release Date and New Gameplay Trailer
notes.notes:
Today, together with developer [i][b]Tiny Roar[/b][/i], we are delighted to reveal the release date of our highly anticipated [b]3D action-adventure RPG, XEL[/b], along with a new cinematic trailer previewing the game’s plot. 

Crash landing on [b]PC here on Steam[/b] and on [b]July 12, 2022[/b], [b]XEL[/b] tells the epic sci-fi journey of [i]Reid[/i], a young woman who becomes stranded on a strange and exotic alien world. Together with her spirited sidekick [i]Chap[/i], [i]Reid[/i] must utilize her ability to jump through space and time to discover the dark secrets of the planet on which she’s landed, and what her connection is to it. 

[b]Too excited to wait until July? Luckily, the first 30 minutes of this space odyssey can be played on here on Steam as a free demo.[/b]

[previewyoutube=gqWVccct2yQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Spaceship-wrecked on the striking, alien world of [b]XEL[/b], [i]Reid[/i] must venture out and begin to piece together her broken memories. A callback to old-school top-down RPGs, [b]XEL[/b] evokes the nostalgic spirit of classic Zelda titles. A true passion project from the devs, the world of [b]XEL[/b] merges familiar ideas with updated mechanics, all woven together in an intense sci-fi mystery. The planet [b]XEL[/b] holds a sinister secret, with darkness lurking across space and time. Aid [i]Reid[/i] in solving the mystery of her history, lest both her and the world she’s somehow connected to be doomed.

[h3]Key Features of XEL:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Old School Meets New School:[/b] Retro meets modern in a classic top-down RPG gameplay style, and a well-crafted combat system comprised of different attacks, dodging, parrying, and clever gadgets
[*] [b]Adventure Through Space and Time:[/b] Explore the mysterious world of [b]XEL[/b] and uncover its dark past, utilizing mind-bending time travel to unlock the secrets of the mysterious land
[*] [b]A Timeless Audiovisual Experience:[/b] Composed by Gidon Wolff, [b]XEL[/b] offers a timeless soundtrack complemented by vibrant visuals, handcrafted by a passionate indie team[/list]

[h2]XEL launches on Windows PC via Steam and GOG July 12, 2022, followed by the launch on Nintendo Switch July 14, 2022.
The grandiose adventure will launch on Xbox Series X/S, Xbox One, and Playstation 4/5 later this year. [/h2]
